data_fields.name: grace_s
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor; check() has no occupancy input

best_idea: Keep one start time and a stage table per spawn group, and work out respawn state only when someone looks, counting the cycles that wrapped since the last look, instead of running a ticker per zone.
decision_why: Same shape as zone respawn timing (cycle length plus stage thresholds evaluated on observation), but the donor's wrap label, unbounded catch-up count and pickled-callback store clash with server-verified state and the one ledger, so take the shape and change those three things.
acceptance: A server test observes a zone after 20 unseen cycles and asserts newCycles is 20, spawns are capped at the zone spawn cap, and the first observation on the wrap moment returns the post-wrap stage, never a loop label.
